title: Framer Redesign
meta: Give your site a fresh, modern Framer redesign that keeps your content and links. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Framer redesign that keeps your content and links
overview: We take your current site, from Framer or another platform, and redesign it in Framer. We review what works, agree a new visual direction with you, then rebuild the pages with fresh layouts, type, imagery and light motion. Your wording, page addresses and search titles carry over where they still serve you. You see a private preview along the way and approve it before anything goes live.

pkgs.blurb: A fresh look for your home page and one key inner page.
A redesigned core site with navigation, footer and motion.
A complete redesign with custom sections and a style guide.

faq: Will a redesign affect my search rankings?
We aim to protect them by keeping addresses, titles and text where possible. Large layout changes can still shift rankings slightly, and no one can promise a particular result.
Do I need to bring a design?
No. Share sites you admire and your brand details and we propose the look. If you already have designs in Figma, we build to match them.
Can you redesign a site that is not on Framer?
Yes. We rebuild it in Framer, which counts as a redesign and a move together. Send your link and we confirm how much carries over.
How many design rounds are there?
Each package includes a set number of revisions, which are shown on the page. We share layouts early, so changes are cheap and nothing is a surprise at the end.
